Adani Airports to invest INR 20,000 cr in airport city projects across six airports
Adani Airport City Limited has announced plans to invest more than INR 20,000 crore in the first phase of integrated airport city developments across six airports in India. Spanning over 655 acres, the projects will combine hotels, retail, offices, entertainment and convention facilities, positioning airports as multi-purpose urban hubs that support tourism, commercial activity and regional economic growth.
